query: What is the current status of SpaceX Starship Flight 13 (IFT-13) as of mid-July 2026? Has Booster 20 completed its static fire test? Has the FAA approved Flight 13 / accepted the Flight 12 mishap investigation? What is the latest NET (no earlier than) launch date shown on trackers like NextSpaceflight and RGV Aerial Photography?
answer:
Research complete. Here is a summary of the key findings on **SpaceX Starship Flight 13 (IFT-13)** as of mid-July 2026:

## Bottom Line
Flight 13 is **fully cleared and go for launch NET Thursday, July 16, 2026, 6:45 p.m. EDT / 5:45 p.m. CDT (2245 GMT)** from Starbase, Texas. It uses **Booster 20** (Super Heavy) and **Ship 40** — the second flight of Starship V3 (Block 3).

## Answers to Your Specific Questions

**1. Has Booster 20 completed its static fire? → YES.**
Booster 20 completed a **25-second static fire of all 33 Raptor engines on July 10, 2026.** (Its cryo proof was June 7; Ship 40 did its own ~60-second static fire July 1.)

**2. Has the FAA approved Flight 13 / accepted the Flight 12 mishap investigation? → YES.**
The FAA **closed the Flight 12 mishap investigation on Monday, July 13, 2026**, accepting SpaceX's findings and corrective actions (no public injuries/property damage). This lifted the launch hold the FAA had imposed on May 27, 2026 after Flight 12 (which flew May 22).

**3. Latest NET on trackers → July 16, 2026.**
- **NextSpaceflight:** July 16, showing **"19/19 Checklist Items Complete"** (all milestones including FAA advisories, NOTAM, NOTMAR met)
- **WhatAboutIt/WAI Hub, RocketLaunch.Live, SpaceLaunchLive:** July 16 at 10:45 PM UTC

**Payload:** 20 Starlink V3 satellites (first V3s to reach space); potentially the final suborbital Starship flight.

**Caveat:** At research time (July 16), the launch had not yet occurred and remained a NET target subject to weather/technical scrubs (conditions were benign — broken clouds, ~9 knots wind).

Note: A minor terminology point — the question referenced "Booster 20" correctly, but note the *upper stage* is Ship 40 (Flight 12 used Booster 19/Ship 39).
